e.title: insurance-online
e.summary: Bandit 定价实验（burning-cost）：GIPP 合规的在线价格实验——UCB1/Thompson 采样
e.summary_en: Bandit pricing experiments (burning-cost): GIPP-compliant online price experimentation — UCB1/Thompson sampling
e.summary_hk: Bandit 定價實驗（burning-cost）：GIPP 合規的在線價格實驗——UCB1/Thompson 採樣
e.body: insurance-online（burning-cost）做 GIPP 合规的在线定价实验：多臂老虎机（bandit）算法——UCB1、Thompson 采样——在价格 A/B 测试中动态分配流量（探索-利用权衡）。对 RIAA：在线实验的效率革命——传统 A/B 测试浪费流量在次优臂，bandit 动态学习（「边实验边赚钱」）；GIPP（一般保险定价实践）合规约束；与 [[insurance-causal-policy]]（离线因果评估）、[[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）配套；适合定价实验与增长方向。
e.body_en: insurance-online (burning-cost) does GIPP-compliant online pricing experiments: multi-armed bandit algorithms — UCB1, Thompson sampling — dynamically allocating traffic in price A/B tests (exploration-exploitation trade-off). For RIAA: the efficiency revolution of online experiments — classical A/B testing wastes traffic on suboptimal arms, bandits learn dynamically ('earning while experimenting'); GIPP (general insurance pricing practices) compliance constraints; pairs with [[insurance-causal-policy]] (offline causal evaluation) and [[insurance-uplift]] (HTE); suits pricing experimentation and growth.
e.body_hk: insurance-online（burning-cost）做 GIPP 合規的在線定價實驗：多臂老虎機（bandit）算法——UCB1、Thompson 採樣——在價格 A/B 測試中動態分配流量（探索-利用權衡）。對 RIAA：在線實驗的效率革命——傳統 A/B 測試浪費流量在次優臂，bandit 動態學習（「邊實驗邊賺錢」）；GIPP（一般保險定價實踐）合規約束；與 [[insurance-causal-policy]]（離線因果評估）、[[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）配套；適合定價實驗與增長方向。
